title: Investigation Evidence Timeline and Analytics Projection Boundary
released_boundary: InvestigationEvidenceTimelineService — a typed reconstruction boundary that assembles content-light investigation timelines from canonical evidence domains, preserves provenance and authority status, and emits deterministic operational and analytical projection contracts for later PostgreSQL and DuckDB consumption.
consumer_purpose: Future Gridline evidence/timeline surfaces and PostgreSQL operational queries can present governed work as a reconstructable product experience rather than scattered receipts and terminal reports.
freeze_condition: frozen pending named integration milestone T4_integration (Gridline surface consumption and PostgreSQL materialization)
deferred_seams: PostgreSQL operational persistence (T2) — T4 publishes a compatible projection contract but does not directly integrate T2 while T2 is unpublished.
Frontend Gridline evidence/timeline surfaces — deferred to UI integration milestone.
DuckDB ingestion of exported timeline datasets — view definitions provided but actual DuckDB table creation deferred.
Live-wiring with real session evidence (observability.jsonl, coordination events.jsonl) from .build/ and ~/.rig/ — test fixtures cover the shape but not live paths.
Receipt store adapter — receipt envelopes are schema-compatible but not explicitly adapted in this slice.
Audit trail adapter — AuditTrailStore.read_events() is compatible but not wired in this slice.
Ralph scan results adapter — Ralph is stateless; scan results must be captured at call time.
Authorization receipt adapter — step-up receipts are compatible but not wired in this slice.
Storage lifecycle events adapter — compatible but not wired.

observability.events_kinds: session started/closed, tool call completed/refused/failed, context request accounted, model observation captured, context assembly reported, governance gate decision, checkpoint committed/refused

coordination.events_kinds: session registered, session heartbeat, task claimed/released, path reserved/released, conflict reported, reservation refused, artifact published, handoff requested/accepted/rejected, projection read, lease expired/stale

disclosure.events_kinds: prepared, authorization_consumed, projection_receipt_persisted, manifest_applied, disclosure_event_recorded, completed, refused, conflict, corrupt, recovery_required

checkpoint.path: same as observability (filtered for checkpoint event names)

publication.events_kinds: publication preview compiled, publication preview refused

unsupported_domains: receipt_store — ReceiptEnvelope schema is compatible; adapter not yet implemented.
audit_trail — AuditTrailStore.read_events() is compatible; adapter not yet implemented.
ralph — stateless scanner; scan results must be captured at call time.
governance/authorization — step-up authorization receipts not yet adapted.

postgresql.authority_separation: derived_projection — canonical evidence ledgers remain the sole authority

degradation_handling.reporting: DegradationSummary in timeline projection with per-classification counts

ordering.test_proven: test_assemble_deterministic_ordering verifies same input → same projection_digest

evidence_artifacts.fixtures: 5 JSONL fixture files with 17 events across 4 domains
evidence_artifacts.test_files: 7 test files covering models, adapters, assembler, degradation, pg_contract, duckdb_export, content_light

config: pyproject.toml (added per-file-ignores for T4 adapter files)

dirty_state.preserved: All pre-existing dirty files preserved. No edits made to S3 lane files.
